title: TICKET-005-RULE3 — Task Contracts
rationale: Encode Rule 3 (Task Contracts): autonomous sprint proposals must include inputs, outputs, success_criteria. CTO Approval Gate rejects proposals missing any of the three. Applies to autonomous_loop and queue-empty-autonomous sources.

tasks.description: Add inputs?: string[], outputs?: string[], success_criteria?: string[] to SprintProposal in scripts/lib/cto-approval-gate.ts

Create scripts/governance/task-contract-checker.ts. Function checkTaskContracts(sprint: SprintProposal): {valid: boolean, missing: string[]}. Checks that sprint.inputs, sprint.outputs, sprint.success_criteria are all present and non-empty arrays. Returns missing field names. Under 40 lines.

Edit scripts/lib/cto-approval-gate.ts: import checkTaskContracts. In requestCTOApproval, after Rule 2 check and before Rule 1 check: if source is autonomous_loop or queue-empty-autonomous, call checkTaskContracts. If !valid: return CTOApprovalResult with approved:false, plan_reference: 'RULE3_CONTRACT_MISSING', reason listing missing fields. Under 15 new lines.
